concerns.text: FR-010 states that the held‑out test set comprises [deferred] of the unified dataset *prior* to any hyper‑parameter tuning, but the actual proportion (e.g., 10 %, 20 %) is left unspecified. Without a concrete split size the design cannot guarantee that the test set is large enough to provide reliable estimates of R², MAE, and the paired‑test p‑value, nor can it ensure that data leakage is avoided. This makes the validation methodology under‑specified and threatens the statistical power of SC‑001 and SC‑006.
